svg.title: prompt injection boundary
svg.desc: An instructional diagram explaining prompt injection boundary in the Agentic AI handbook.

g.text: Prompt injection crosses the data-to-instruction boundary
Label provenance and keep untrusted text as data • Retrieve only authorized sources
Validate and authorize every tool call • Require approval for risky effects
Restrict network egress and secrets • Log the evidence, proposal, decision, and effect
